info.title: MikoshiTracker API v1
info.description: Versioned, self-describing API for MikoshiTracker. Uniform envelope ({ok,data} / {ok,code,error}), typed error codes, paginated lists, and OpenAPI components. Converges with the companion mikoshi /api/v1 conventions so a single frontend or AI tool can consume both.

bearerAuth.description: Personal API token, circle token, or the admin API key, depending on the operation's auth scope.

get.summary: List the caller's events (cursor-paginated audit feed)
Get one event with its mutation history

post.summary: Record an event for an entry
Update an event's payload or note
Undo the latest mutation on an event

get.summary: Today's pending/completed habits with completion rate
Aggregate entry payloads over a date range (powers the diet/kcal page)
30-day overview: today/weekly rates, trends, stability ranking
God-mode: list all circles with member counts
God-mode: list all entries across users
God-mode: list all entry events across users

post.summary: Freeze a circle's current leaderboard standings into a season snapshot

get.summary: List frozen leaderboard snapshots for a circle (optionally one season)
